title: Capability Growth Ledger — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Records what a system can demonstrably do, what changed, and which tests substantiate each claim. Every capability claim gets a ledger entry: what the system can do, what changed to enable it, and the exact tests that prove it — no proof, no entry. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success. "Boundless" means the capacity to extend this system, not a claim that its records or capabilities are already infinite. Record counts reported are actual populated counts; generated records are labeled "generated" and never mixed with sourced facts.
